title: Channel 24

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Welcome to Channel 24, Sacramento’s newest music venue and event space. Conveniently located in the heart of Midtown Sacramento, the venue was established in 2025 by Another Planet Entertainment (APE) - the largest independent promoter in the United States. The event space is home to an impressive 2,150 capacity main room, multiple bars, an open-air patio and an exclusive upgrade lounge featuring a private bar and restrooms. Whether you’re planning a corporate meeting, holiday party, or film shoot, Channel 24 is all about bringing people together for memorable experiences. The heart of the venue, Channel 24’s Main Room boasts tasteful design elements, including LED lighting and a proscenium
